title: Grateful Dead Live at Palace Theater on 1972-09-23
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT > CDR > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Sonically enhanced, remastered, retracked upgrade of shnid 2201; Mastered and tracked by Bill Guarneri, July 25, 2014

ai_review.summary: Decent recording with a tasty Bird Song and a standout Big River, though fans view it as an average entry in this legendary run.
ai_review.review: The show earns praise for a powerful rendition of "Bird Song" and what one reviewer calls the greatest performance of "Big River" ever. While some listeners find the overall set solid and played with gusto, others feel it falls short compared to nearby shows from the same period. No specific audio issues are mentioned, so the recording is generally regarded as acceptable.

ai_rating.rationale: Four reviews give an average of 3.75 stars; positive remarks focus on a couple of standout songs, while comments about overall quality are lukewarm and no technical details are provided.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not discuss sound clarity or mix; the few comments (“Not bad”, “Incredible!!”) suggest the audio is at least listenable with no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed commentary on set structure; reviewers feel the show is solid but not as strong as other shows from the same two‑week stretch.
